summary: Clearer release manager refusals, dev images that expire, safer chart publication, chart-only manifests, a new action for extra charts. Existing inputs are unchanged, except one build-image combination that now fails (see the note): repin the actions.

changes.description: notify-rm tells a refused credential (401) from a refused declaration (403), quotes the release manager's reason and titles its annotations.
changelog reads feat!: and feat(scope)!: as breaking changes.

build-image builds an image that expires without attestations, so dev images expire on Quay; expires-after with an explicit provenance or sbom now fails before the build: drop them or set them to false.
publish-chart creates the destination of helm pull and stops when the presence check fails for another reason than an absent version.
publish-chart builds the dependencies of an apiVersion v1 chart (requirements.yaml) and skips the build when they are all in charts/.
publish-extra-chart pushes a chart that repackages an upstream release, with its own appVersion; notify-rm takes it as app-version.
release-manifest writes the manifest of a chart-only component (chart-only: true).
version reads an anchor tag vX.Y.Z-0, which names the next release of a branch where no release tag leads to it.
The repository releases itself with the standard publication files and workflows, documented in docs/releasing.md.
